_meta.description: Sample negotiation transcript demonstrating multi-issue context-aware counteroffer evaluation and package trade-offs. Manually authored reference example, not an automated Gemini output.

agents.primaryGoal: Obtain an acceptable compensation package and suitable working conditions.
constraints: Joining date must be >= 30 days from offer (contractual notice period)
Must have >= 2 remote work days per week

agents.primaryGoal: Hire a suitable candidate within the approved compensation budget and company policies.
constraints: Base salary must not exceed $105,000 USD/year
Joining date must be <= 60 days from offer
Remote work days must not exceed 3 days per week
Annual bonus must not exceed 10% of base

turns.message: We are excited to extend an initial offer with a base salary of $92,000, a 5% performance bonus, starting in 30 days, with 2 remote days per week.
turns.decision_explanation: Opened at conservative $92k to stay safely within the $105k approved band while meeting candidate minimum $90k requirement.

turns.message: Thank you for the offer. Based on my specialized AI engineering experience and market benchmarks, I am targeting a base of $102,000 with an 8% bonus and 3 remote days. I would be able to start in 45 days after completing my transition.
turns.decision_explanation: Acknowledged offer meets baseline ($92k >= $90k), but counteroffered near upper range ($102k) with 45-day start date and 3 remote days.

turns.message: A base salary of $102,000 exceeds our internal equity benchmarks for this role tier. We can increase the base to $95,000 with a 6% bonus ($5,700). However, the team requires your on-site presence at 3 days per week, and we need you to start within 35 days.
turns.decision_explanation: Evaluated candidate counteroffer. Pushed base from $92k to $95k, but held remote work to 2 days to satisfy team collaboration policy.

turns.message: I am willing to compromise on the schedule by agreeing to your 35-day start date and the 2 days remote arrangement. In return, I request that we adjust the base salary to $98,000 with an 8% bonus to bridge the overall value gap.
turns.decision_explanation: Made significant concessions on start date (45d -> 35d) and remote days (3d -> 2d). Counteroffered by demanding a smaller price move to $98k base.

turns.message: We appreciate your flexibility on the start date and on-site commitments. We can stretch our base salary authorization to $97,000 and approve the 8% annual performance bonus ($7,760), bringing your total compensation potential to $104,760.
turns.decision_explanation: Evaluated total package: $97k base is comfortably under $105k cap. Approved 8% bonus (under 10% policy cap). Proposed near candidate's target.

turns.message: With total compensation reaching $104,760, a $97,000 base, 2 remote days per week, and a 35-day start, this package satisfies all my core objectives. I am delighted to accept your offer.
turns.decision_explanation: Accepted offer. $97k base exceeds $90k reservation limit; total compensation exceeds $100k target; start date (35d >= 30d) and remote (2d >= 2d) satisfied.

turns.message: Negotiation concluded successfully via multi-issue counteroffers in Round 3. All employer constraints (salary <= $105k, bonus <= 10%, start <= 60d) and candidate constraints (salary >= $90k, start >= 30d, remote >= 2d) verified.
